newsitem.title: USA: CoreStaff sued for trademark infringement.
newsitem.headline: CoreStaff sued for trademark infringement.

text.p: Core Staffing Services Inc sued CoreStaff Inc for trademark infringement and unfair competition, said court papers filed on Monday in the U.S. Southern District Court of New York.
Core Staffing said that within the past two years, it had rejected CoreStaff's offer to purchase Core Staffing.

Core Staffing said that after it rejected CoreStaff's purchase offer, CoreStaff purchased a competitor, Leafstone Inc, in 1996 and began operating in the New York-area under the CoreStaff name in the spring of 1997.

Core Staffing is requesting an injunction against CoreStaff to prevent CoreStaff from using either the "Core" or "Core-Staff" name in the states of New York, New Jersey or Connecticut, an accounting of Core Staffing's actual damages and $1 million in punitive damages.
CoreStaff was not immediately available to comment on this lawsuit.
Core Staffing, based in New York City, provides employment and temporary service workers to various companies in the New York metropolitan area.
CoreStaff Inc provides information, technology and staffing services via temporary and contract personnel.
